name: manual_fba170
claim: Ollama and LM Studio CAN run concurrently on this Mac for light-to-moderate single-request workloads -- the documented Mac inference-mode table (Ollama=active/warm primary, LM Studio=passive/probe-only) is an operational convention/division-of-labor choice, not a hard technical impossibility.

decisions.notes: Directly tested 2026-08-30: with Ollama already holding qwen3.5:9b-mlx loaded in memory, launched LM Studio and loaded qwen3.5-9b-mlx there too. Both /v1/completions (LM Studio) and /api/generate (Ollama) responded correctly to real requests while the other was also active. Claude-Desktop-LLM's check_llm_status tool (queries both providers concurrently in one call) reported both connected with correct default models, no errors, no hang. Free memory was tight (~865MB free pages) but nothing failed for this single-request-at-a-time test. Does not rule out contention under sustained/heavy concurrent load from both engines at once -- only disproves the strict 'cannot run both, period' framing for light usage.
